svg.title: The same 4 KiB transfer costs the CPU 100%, 20%, 0.14% or 0.007% of its time
svg.text: The same 4 KiB transfer costs the CPU 100%, 20%, 0.14% or 0.007% of its time
CPU time spent on the transfer (blue) over the 41 ms the device needs. Assumed numbers, see the table.
The thin lines for buffer interrupts and DMA are drawn wider than to scale, or they would be invisible.
